status: Seven installed structures. Native placement in four rotations, support, under-deck transport, water retention/spill parity and walking passed main 90; exact save/reload and six walking destinations passed 91. Eight concrete platform size/height variants are authored and export-checked; native placement untested. Three concrete side platforms (legless decks hung beside a reinforced dam block) are authored; native placement untested. Initial cost balance.

buildings.name: Sandstone masonry block
buildings.description: Mortared sandstone retaining block. Holds back water and supports construction on its top.

buildings.name: Limestone masonry block
buildings.description: Dressed limestone retaining block. Holds back water and supports construction on its top.

buildings.name: Concrete levee block
buildings.description: Cast concrete foundation and retaining block. Holds back water and supports buildings.

buildings.name: Reinforced overhang 8×1
buildings.description: A reinforced deck with one supported anchor tile and seven cantilever tiles. Supports construction above; does not hold back water.

buildings.name: Concrete platform 3×3 (3 high)
buildings.description: A tall, wide construction deck on four corner supports. Leaves a clear central bay for paths, power shafts and tubeways. Supports construction above; does not hold back water.

buildings.name: Reinforced dam block
buildings.description: A solid concrete dam module with exposed steel bands. Holds back water and supports construction. Concrete side platforms can hang from its side, level with its top.

buildings.name: Concrete overflow dam
buildings.description: A concrete spill sill under a supported deck. Retains water to 0.65 of a layer; excess water flows through the upper opening.

buildings.name: Concrete platform 3×3 (1 high)
buildings.description: A 3×3 construction deck on four corner supports 1 layer high. Leaves a clear bay below for paths, power shafts and tubeways. Supports construction above; does not hold back water.
